title: Cute Ballet Princess Clipart Bundle
author: Diy Crafts Ideas
description:
DIY Crafts Idea brings you creative art and design!
DIY Crafts Idea promises to provide the latest bundles of awesome PNG sublimation designs, which you can apply our digital art to any projects and uses going with various creative collection designs such as seasonal holidays, important events yearly, Birthday party, Home decor, Sport, Black girl magic, and so on. Every cute design is made smooth and awesome to details, perfect to every line, and careful to every pattern. Let’s discover your favorite graphic designs today!
I. DIGITAL FILE FORMAT:
Cute Ballet Princess Clipart Bundle. You will receive the PNG version with high resolution:
*PNG file 300 Dpi 4500 x 5400 pixels to be used as clipart, sublimation designs, Heat press transfers, HTV Cameo, Silhouette, and so on.
The file is ready to use with all other major electronic cutting machines. Moreover, They can work perfectly with Silhouette Studio, Cricut Design Space, and other cutting software that accepts the offered file types. Then, you can create your own products for example Signs, Decals, T-Shirts, Bags, Mugs, Tumblers, Pillows, Covers & anything else you want to apply on.
Thank you and have a nice day,
Love you all,
DIY Crafts Idea Studio
